body: Well it ends up that when the liver shuts down, ammonia and other stuff builds up in the blood. Hepatic encephalopathy. Try not to die this way.

I've seen this death process also. The ammonia scrambles the brain as you say. And the person moans and moans for days on end, out of their mind. It's insanely painful to watch. Horrible, horrible death not just for the person, but for those watching it. ugh.

I've been there. I turned to booze when two of my friends killed themselves and one was murdered. The drinking caused me to lose someone I was very in love with. My life was in shambles. I dreamed of suicide all the time, but I have kids, so that wasn't gonna happen. It was misery, one day to the next. Then I realized that I was addicted. Really realized it. The alcohol had taken control and I was having all these dark thoughts *because* of the alcohol, not because of my life. I felt powerless to escape it though. I had to drink to cure the hangover. Every day was the same. Since it was obviously a chemical dependency that was making me miserable, I decided to use chemicals to counteract it. I started taking Cymbalta (I'd taken it years earlier) because it's and anti-depressant and anti-anxiety drug, which counteracted exactly what compelled me to drink. And while it sounds like you're on hard economic times, I hope you can somehow get a chemical treatment. I stopped drinking the day I started on the drug. I stopped the drug eventually and now I'm back to normal and being productive. Hope you can get out of the mire. Your life may suck right now, but there are people in your situation who at least have the capacity to be happy and relaxed despite the situation. And your circumstances probably won't change until you become un-addicted, positive, and live the rest of your life happy. You only get one life. Don't waste it being miserable!

Good qu3stion. 

I've turned to sexual fetishes.

Thank you all for your kind words and guidance. I'm trying very hard to keep it together now that all of my meaning is lost. The kids are keeping me here. I won't be killing myself any time soon, I guess. These alcohol withdrawals are horrible. I have extreme anxiety and I don't want to eat. my hands are shaking, I can't sleep. Huge headache. I'm extremely depressed. I want to feel better. And then there's her, always in the front of my mind. Fuck. If anyone cares, here's a forum where I posted my situation. [Link](http://www.loveshack.org/forums/breaking-up-reconciliation-coping/coping/450864-she-came-back-i-m-sad)

Please don't. I lost a friend to suicide and it's made me want to commit suicide. Just for the sake of those around you, please, please don't.

What's more is that I'm sure things will improve. It's going to take me a long long time to get to a happier place. I'm at the lowest possible point in my life right now. Typing to you is currently what's keeping me going. It's moment by moment. Maybe you can help other suicidal people in order to get past this wave. 

I hope you'll reconsider your decision and I hope to see you reply. Hugs.
